cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`.

limit.description: Page size. The community chooses when absent (50 in the reference implementation).

tag.description: Only rooms carrying this tag. Absent: every room the community owns.

states.description: Only rooms in one of these states of their owner's lifecycle. Absent: every state but `removed`, so that a removed room — a record that it existed, and nothing in it — leaves the list unless asked for.

Response.title: VTC Rooms Community List — response payload
Response.description: Success response to vtc/rooms/community/list. Type https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/rooms/community/list/0.4#response. One page of the rooms the community owns, in the states asked for.

nextCursor.description: Present when more remain; pass it as `cursor`.
